signature: cugraph_sssp(table_name, source_vertex [, src_col, dst_col [, weight_col [, options_json]]])
result_schemas_json: {"call_specific_authority":"cugraph_validate_call","default_schema":"default","note":"Generic registry schemas; run cugraph_validate_call for the concrete table-specific output schema.","schemas":{"default":{"fields":[{"data_type":"Int64","name":"vertex","nullable":false},{"data_type":"Float64","name":"distance","nullable":false},{"data_type":"Int64","name":"predecessor","nullable":true}]}}}
options_schema_json: {"algorithm_options":{"cutoff":{"default":null,"min":0.0,"scope":"algorithm","type":"Float64|null"}},"graph_options":{"construction_policy":{"allowed_values":["python_cugraph","raw_libcugraph"],"default":"python_cugraph","description":"Edge-list construction semantics used before calling libcugraph.","scope":"graph","type":"Utf8"},"directed":{"default":true,"description":"Whether graph construction treats edges as directed.","scope":"graph","type":"Boolean"},"renumber":{"default":true,"description":"Whether graph construction may renumber external vertex identifiers internally.","scope":"graph","type":"Boolean"}}}
argument_descriptions_json: [{"name":"table_name","required":true,"type":"Utf8"},{"name":"source_vertex","required":true,"type":"Int64"},{"default":"src","name":"src_col","required":false,"type":"Utf8"},{"default":"dst","name":"dst_col","required":false,"type":"Utf8"},{"name":"weight_col","note":"optional edge weight column for graph construction when supported by the algorithm","required":false,"semantic_effect":"edge weights affect algorithm results when provided","type":"Utf8|null"},{"name":"options_json","note":"","required":false,"type":"Utf8"}]
result_field_descriptions_json: [{"description":"Vertex reached by the shortest-path traversal.","name":"vertex"},{"description":"Shortest weighted-path distance from the source vertex.","name":"distance"},{"description":"Previous vertex on the shortest-path tree, null for the source or unreachable vertices.","name":"predecessor"}]
limitations_json: ["dry-run validates table resolution, column presence, static dtypes, and options only","dry-run does not scan edge data, construct a graph, or prove source-vertex existence"]
